Awesome experience
Aug 2026 • Solo
I had the most amazing meal at Air Sushi. The staff were very friendly, the food was quick to arrive but of great quality. 

Highly recommend the pan-seared salmon — absolutely delicious! I also had the edamame and the karaage Japanese fried chicken, which was so tasty and surprisingly not too greasy.

I also had a glass of red wine with dinner, and after struggling to find a really good glass of red since arriving in Da Nang, this one definitely did not disappoint! 🍷

Great food, great wine and a lovely time overall. Would definitely come back! ✨

Delicious
Aug 2026 • Family
Closed the gestalt on fresh fish at this restaurant! 🍣
We took a set of 5 types of sushi and signature rolls. The fish just melts in your mouth—you can feel that the quality is premium, without the unpleasant smell of "thawing." A special delight - the eel roll: the sauce is tender, and the rice is of perfect consistency.
The portions are large, you won't leave hungry. The staff gave me tips on combinations, thanks for that separately. Now this is my power spot for Japanese cuisine. I will definitely be back! 🔥
